+### Resumed scope reconciliation — 2026-10-18
+
+The prior source slice is preserved, not repeated or described as complete
+consolidation. Compiler ownership is now explicitly recorded for Hermes's
+provisioning worker `sa-0-32370f11` (21:45Z dispatch). The earlier PID25761
+observation above is historical, not a current process receipt. ReleaseReadiness
+found no authoritative terminal receipt releasing that ownership; this resumed
+pass has not probed or polled compiler processes. Its scratch build excludes
+consolidation and cannot certify these source changes.
+
+The following decisions supersede the non-specific “removal candidate” and
+“remain distinct” wording above. Source-only inspections do not prove execution.
+
+#### MCP and cron
+
+- **Defer native-contract migration:** `mcp.get_config` and
+  `mcp.configure_server`. Preserve both outer and nested exact grants and the
+  server-descendant-only patch restriction, currently delegating to
+  `tched_router.GetMcpConfig` / `PatchConfig`. Neither whole-config access nor
+  CLI stdout is an equivalent replacement. `mcp_methods.rs:36-109` owns these
+  restrictions; no caller, policy or method is removed by this deferral.
+- **Retain local projection policy:** `mcp.configure_tool_groups`; this is not
+  permission to implement the future lungs MCP interface.
+- **Defer native-contract migration, retain existing receipt/publication
+  integration:** cron `create_job`, `delete_job`, `disable_job`, `enable_job`,
+  `get_history`, `get_job`, `list_jobs`, `run_job`, `update_job`. Existing callers
+  and typed results remain unchanged. The original inventory records incomplete
+  native history/run capture; install-global scheduling is not re-described as
+  private scheduling or continuous initiator-grant enforcement.
+
+#### Gemma local responsibilities
+
+Retain these sixteen methods, rather than treating the whole plugin as native
+inference duplication:
+
+| Methods | Retained responsibility |
+|---|---|
+| `register_tag` | Revision-checked private taxonomy mutation. |
+| `list_tags`, `list_perspectives` | Validated taxonomy enumeration/counts. |
+| `classify`, `analyze_intent` | Deterministic keyword matching/ranking against registered taxonomy, not provider completion. |
+| `get_ui_workspace`, `get_ui_spec`, `get_ui_job`, `list_ui_specs` | Principal/session-owned committed workspace/spec/job reads. |
+| `create_ui_spec`, `update_ui_spec`, `handle_ui_event`, `delete_ui_spec`, `delete_ui_job` | Private durable json-render mutations, revisions, admission, publication and owned task lifetime. |
+| `rebind_ui_renderer`, `recover_ui_workspace` | Renderer/catalog-pin reconciliation and durable-to-private-SHM recovery. |
+
+Evidence: `gemma_brain_methods.rs:179-299`,
+`ui_workspace_dispatch.rs:51-78,370-545`, `ui_workspace_contract.rs`.
+Canonical `tched_router.ResolveRoute` is separate from these responsibilities.
+
+#### Model registry
+
+| Method | Disposition and caller impact |
+|---|---|
+| `list_providers` | Retain local governed-provider/Cozo catalog projection: discovery status/revision, credential class, availability counts and control-plane profiles. UI `model-catalog.ts:89-95` remains unchanged. |
+| `list_models` | Retain local Cozo catalog query, credential/enabled gates, availability, pagination, search and recorded profiles. UI `model-catalog.ts:118-124` remains unchanged. |
+| `refresh` | Retain credential-gated discovery ingestion and folding into Cozo, including discovery history and removed providers. |
+| `set_model_profile` | Retain validated per-provider/model control-plane profile assignment and catalog revision/readback; not global native selection. |
+| `maintain_credentials` | Retain governed provider classification/reference policy (`key`/`oauth`/`off`/`remove`), not credential values or replacement native authentication. |
+| `native_list_providers` | Defer native inventory contract migration; retain agent-owned-profile unselectability and door-policy filtering. CLI `providers.list` is not an equivalent filtered result. |
+
+Evidence: `model_registry_dispatch.rs:364-736,858-1078` and
+`tched_router_runtime.rs:1288-1326`. No methods or callers removed here.
+
+#### Cognitive: exhaustive nine-group disposition
+
+The original 670-method partition is retained: 567+59+18+7+3+6+2+2+6.
+These are source decisions, not a claim that native functionality is absent.
+
+| Group / names | Disposition and dependency |
+|---|---|
+| 567 persona consultations: 81 personas × `advise`, `analyze`, `consult`, `explain`, `help`, `recommend`, `review` | Defer native persona/config translation under OD-122; retain current caller mode/route, scoped memory, dynamic persona/context, role/knowledge and guarded provider-only completion. No caller contract changes. |
+| 59 execution catalog methods | Retain exact-grant/project-restricted identity-bearing `UnifiedExecution.ExecuteCatalog` integration and process result semantics; defer unproven native-tools replacement. |
+| 18 orchestration methods: six agents × `list_steps`, `run_workflow`, `validate` | Retain authenticated canonical child calls with original actor/session/genesis and each child's exact capability; defer native SOP/pipeline substitution. |
+| `memory_store`, `memory_retrieve`, `memory_query`, `memory_recall`, `memory_delete`, `memory_list_namespaces`, `memory_semantic_query` | Retain scoped Cozo ownership and explicit semantic-mirror errors; defer native memory under OD-123. `memory_recall` remains a local query alias, not independent native integration. |
+| `code_search`, `code_context`, `code_index` | Retain Voyage/Qdrant retrieval/indexing, collection/filter/context semantics and server-bound session context; defer native replacement until equivalent results are established. |
+| `rust_pro`, `python_pro`, `typescript_pro`, `sequential_thinking`, `context_manager`, `code_review_orchestrator` | Defer local alias retirement with demonstrated HOT-policy dependency. These normalize to catalog methods; migrate exact HOT entries/consumers together, not under OD-122/123. |
+| `workflow_query`, `workflow_run` | Defer outer-alias retirement with HOT-policy reconciliation; retain workstack owner and identity-bearing `query_workflows` / `start_workflow` calls. Not a missing-native-capture justification. |
+| `specialist`, `gemini_query` | Retain dynamic scoped consultation for `specialist`, native persona translation deferred under OD-122. Separately defer `gemini_query` migration pending a concrete equivalent for research answers/citations and incomplete-research errors. |
+| `get_health`, `list_tools`, `invoke_tool`, `schema_read`, `oscal_subids`, `toolsets` | Retain runtime health, admitted discovery/target-grant enforcement, sealed-schema/OSCAL reads and audience/toolset policy. Generic invocation never grants the target capability. |
